name: Apple-Glazed Tofu with Mashed Parsnips & Arugula-Pumpkin Seed Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium parsnips
½ small pkg fresh thyme
2 Gala apples
½ (5 oz) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice parsnips. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until parsnips can be easily pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Place leaves in a medium bowl along with flour and spices; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles. Add to the bowl with the flour mixture and gently turn to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and pan-fry until golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with any drippings for later use).
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Quarter, core, and slice apples into ½-inch wedges. Add to the bowl with the onion.

When the tofu is done, return the skillet (with any drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and apple; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Add broth, vinegar, Dijon, and maple syrup to the skillet, then stir to combine the sauce. Return tofu to the skillet and turn to coat. Bring sauce to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Once the sauce is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until apple is soft and sauce has thickened slightly, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place half in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining garlic for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp pure maple syrup
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add arugula and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
When the parsnips are done, drain and return to the pan along with remaining garlic, milk, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 fl oz (¼ cup) whole milk
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide parsnip mash, tofu, and salad between plates. Top tofu with apples and sauce from the skillet. Enjoy!
